answerText: Yes, there are numerous spot elevations (such as EG and SW) and contour lines on both sides of the proposed low profile walls along Collier Street. The approximate height of the walls can be determined by calculating the difference between the elevations on the street side and the property side.

reasoning: By examining the northern property boundary along Collier Street, there are proposed low profile walls indicated by a specific linetype from the legend. Adjacent to these walls, there are existing grade (EG) spot elevations on the street side and proposed sidewalk (SW) or finished grade (FG) elevations on the property side. The difference between these elevations provides the approximate height of the walls.
